result.title: HodgePhaseNet: Discrete Hodge Decomposition of Semantic Flows in Transformer Attention
result.summary: WavePhaseNet introduced frequency-resolved semantic representations, QuantumPhaseNet introduced gauge-covariant phase connections, and ModularPhaseNet made a finite cyclic phase channel and its cycle holonomy computable in an ordinary Transformer. These constructions are complementary, yet they do not by themselves separate an observed collection of pairwise relations into a globally consistent direction, circulation around local compositions, and circulation that persists around a larger unfilled cycle. HodgePhaseNet addresses this separation by representing semantic transitions as an antisymmetric real-valued 1-cochain on a finite oriented simplicial complex. With vertex-edge incidence matrix $B_1$ and edge-face incidence matrix $B_2$, every such field has a unique orthogonal decomposition $Ω= B_1^TΦ+ B_2Ψ+ H$, where $B_1H=0$ and $B_2^TH=0$. The three component fields are unique even when their potentials are not. We give explicit projectors, a sparse implementation, integrability and gauge results, a verified numerical example, and a redesigned attention interface. The attention bias is defined on allowed ordered query-key pairs, remains consistent under arbitrary choices of edge orientation, and preserves a decoder's causal information boundary by constructing its complex from the visible prefix. Gauge invariance of the attention output is conditional on using invariant or appropriately compensated features. A simple difference of vertex embeddings has no coexact or harmonic component; a genuine relation encoder is therefore indispensable. Local circulation is not automatically contradiction, and harmonic flow is not automatically missing knowledge. These interpretations and any reduction in factual error require controlled empirical evaluation. This paper presents a mathematical and architectural proposal, not external natural-language performance results.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HodgePhaseNet，把 Transformer 注意力中的成对语义关系建模为有限单纯复形上的反对称 1-上链，Hodge 分解为梯度、旋度与调和三分量，并给出显式投影算子、稀疏实现和改造后的注意力接口。
AI.relevance_reason: 把关系场拆成一致方向、局部循环与未闭合全局循环的分解思路，可能为分析 VLM 内部 latent 对实体关系的编码是否完整、区分「矛盾」与「缺失信息」提供线索；其注意力偏置接口与因果信息边界构造可供核查能否用于视觉证据筛选与推理状态的组织。
